text:
Relive the drama! Following a thrilling 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich , Inter Milan has secured their spot in the Champions League semi-final . This article dives into the key moments of the match, Lautaro Martinez ‘s inspiring words, and what’s next for Inter Milan in their quest for the #ChampionsLeague title. Read on to get the full recap of this epic clash and Inter Milan’s exciting future!

Inter Milan Advances to Champions league Semifinal After Thrilling Draw Against Bayern Munich april 16, 2025
Lautaro Martinez of FC Internazionale celebrates scoring his teamS first goal during the UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Quarter Final Second Leg match between FC internazionale Milano and FC Bayern München at San Siro on April 16, 2025 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Match Overview: A Night of High Drama Inter Milan secured a spot in the Champions League semi-final after a 2-2 draw with Bayern Munich at San Siro on April 16,2025. The result, combined with Inter’s 2-1 victory in Munich, gave them a 4-2 aggregate win.
the game was a rollercoaster, featuring goals from Harry Kane, Lautaro Martinez, Benjamin Pavard, and Eric Dier.Inter will now face Barcelona in the semi-final.
Key moments of the Match Harry Kane’s Opener: Kane’s goal ignited a fierce response from Inter. Martinez and Pavard’s Quickfire Goals: Within nine minutes, Martinez and Pavard turned the game around from corner situations. Dier’s Equalizer: Eric Dier’s looping header leveled the score, setting up a tense finish. Lautaro Martinez’s Post-Match Comments Lautaro Martinez praised his team’s resilience and determination after the match.
It was certainly an epic match and one we will remember for a long time, because Inter have two giant balls.
Lautaro Martinez, Amazon Prime Video Italia
He further emphasized the team’s spirit, stating, There is so much hard work and sacrifice in this qualification. We do not give up, we’ve got both head and heart.It’s true, we suffered at moments in the game, but we can aim high.
Looking Ahead: Treble Dreams and Barcelona Challenge this marks Inter’s second Champions League semi-final appearance in the last three years. They lost the 2023 final to Manchester City.
Inter’s ambitions extend beyond the Champions League. The team is currently leading Serie A and is set to compete in the Coppa Italia semi-final against Milan.
Martinez highlighted the team’s ambition: Every year, we start out believing we can win it all, or else we wouldn’t bother playing this sport. I thank all the staff, my teammates and the fans, who are our 12 th man.
